name: Jung's Aion — Self, Christ/Antichrist, Fishes, Alchemy, and the Historical Shadow
description: The complete interpretive movement: ego and shadow, the Christ-image and its excluded contrary, the fishes' doubled time, the alchemical work and its scientific aftermath, the quaternio with its declared modern reconstruction, and the age becoming visible as an age.

scenes.name: Ego, shadow, and the image of perfection
scenes.character: The ego as centre of reference meets the shadow; the Christ-image gives wholeness a human face; Antichrist belongs to the ensuing drama as the excluded contrary made historically active.

entities.name: the ego — centre of reference, rooted beyond what it knows of itself
the shadow — recognised through moral effort; projection returning the rejected face
the Christ-image — the Self given a human face; exclusively luminous, not all the opposites
Antichrist — the compensatory counter-image within the same aeon

text.kicker: #1 · Aion chs. I–V (paraphrased from the consulted 1979 paperback; §/page locators in the house)
text.title: Ego, shadow, and the image of perfection
text.italic: The sequence demonstrates the psychology: an exclusively good and luminous figure does not include all the opposites active in the psyche — recognising an evil factor as real confers no goodness on evil acts.

text.body: The ego appears as centre of reference for conscious contents. The shadow requires moral effort: projection returns the rejected face, and isolation seems to confirm a hostile world. The Christ-image gives wholeness a human face, but an exclusively luminous figure does not include all the opposites; against privatio boni evil's efficacy stays in view, and the excluded contrary acquires a compensatory historical figure.
Occurrences: the shadow and projection (#1, recalled at the Shadow Quaternio #4); the double inflation danger (#1); the privatio boni argument (#1); the compensatory Antichrist (#1, #2).

scenes.character: Pisces lets the double figure acquire duration; the precessional spring-point; the Pistis Sophia child-double embracing; the overlapping ram and fish; Leviathan becoming food.

entities.name: Pisces — the two fishes of the age, head to tail
the precessional spring-point — expectation as a historical actor
the Pistis Sophia double — bound, released, embraced, one
Leviathan split against itself, then food for the devout (chs. IX)

text.title: The fishes give the age its temporal image
text.italic: The doubled figure embodies an age living its contrary tendencies successively while the constellational image holds them together — an inherited forecast is not a confirmed causal law of history.

text.body: Christian interpretation gives Christ and the devil shared animal symbols. Pisces lets the double figure acquire duration; the precessional calculations remain Jung's interpretive chronology. The Pistis Sophia double — bound, released, embraced, one — keeps reunion distinct from antagonism. Epiphanius's rite is a pagan rite used as testimony. Leviathan splits against itself and ends as food for the devout — terror, opposition and nourishment as successive offices.

Occurrences: the shared animal symbols (#2); the precessional calculations (#2, historicised at #5→0); the embracing double (#2); Leviathan's conversion into meal (#2, distinct from the authored Meal whole).

scenes.name: The fish is caught, worked, and made to transform
scenes.character: The round creature heated to radiance; the eyewash; the Echeneis reversal — the magnet that attracts the attracting power; Mercurius as substance and philosophy; science born as the mother recedes.

entities.name: the round sea creature — bonesless, heated with sea water until it shines
the eyewash — the preparation becoming the capacity to see
the Echeneis — the small fish that halts ships; the magnet taught to attract it
Mercurius — substance and philosophy; the lapis within darkness
the aftermath — science born, the mother receding as outlived; the investigating psyche disappearing from the account

text.title: The fish is caught, worked, and made to transform
text.italic: The work demonstrates the reversal: the practitioner works with the power that previously held the vessel — the substance's alteration returning as an alteration in the capacity to see.

text.body: Alchemy alters the participant's position: the image becomes something to find and work upon. A round sea creature without bones is heated with sea water until it shines; the preparation becomes an eyewash — the substance's alteration returning as an alteration in the capacity to see. The Echeneis that halts ships is met by a magnet taught to attract the fish. Mercurius names substance and philosophy.

Occurrences: the heated creature and eyewash (#3); the Echeneis reversal and the taught magnet (#3); the two yoked fishes kept distinct (#3); the scientific aftermath and the forgotten condition (#3, #5→0).

text.kicker: #4 · Aion chs. XIII–XV (§§287–427; the quaternio at §§402–421)
text.title: The quaternio — Anthropos, Shadow, Physis, lapis
text.italic: Jung's schema demonstrates a dynamic process within the Self — and the project's reading of the diamonds stays Offered with human-amplified: no: the Shadow's field is not the Anthropos field relabelled.

text.body: The Gnostic return reaches back before the era's images of attraction: the Naassene water of doctrine, the Peratic serpent-Son, Monoïmos's investigation. The four major states are Anthropos A, Shadow B, Physis/serpent C, lapis D, with lower-case transformations; at p.259 the connected diamonds show each whole unfolding into four and passing onward. Jung declares the Shadow Quaternio a modern reconstruction; the return changes an unconscious totality into a conscious one.
Occurrences: the declared modern reconstruction of the Shadow (#4, keeping the project's Offered reading honest); the connected diamonds (p.259); the conclusion's responsibility (#1, #4).

text.title: The age becomes visible as an age
text.italic: The whole returns-to the project as historical de-monopolisation: contrary images and transforming practices expose the history within a seemingly immediate background — and the person must still judge and act.

text.body: The project operation is historical de-monopolisation: an age inherits a governing image; the image becomes an apparently immediate background of judgment; its exclusions remain active. Generative and historical succession stay distinct. Christ/Antichrist is held at the occupied slash after the native derivation; the exact symbolic appointments stay human-amplified: no. Every later index must return to this complete whole and preserve its particular action.
Occurrences: the governing image's background operation (#1–#4, #5→0); the Shadow Quaternio's declared modernity (#4, #5→0); the sixteen recovered passage locations as the house's standing (#5→0).
